name: fm-adt-helper
description: Agentic FileMaker development for ADT-equipped machines — installed INSTEAD of fm-dc wherever the Claris Agentic Development Toolkit (ADT 0.4.0) CLIs are present. Carries the ADT workflow doctrine: two-lane architecture (fm CLI schema lane needs no handshake; MCP/script lane rides the connector), NDJSON ops discipline, connection lifecycle + unwedge playbook, web viewer app pipeline, native layout authoring with its rendering traps, and the master quirks list. Ships the ADT Helper FileMaker plug-in (window snapshots for visual verification).
